Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: React Native CI/CD

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
    paths-ignore:
      - "**.md"
      - "examples/**"
      - "apps/**"
      - ".vscode/**"
      - ".yarn/**"
      - ".gitignore"
      - ".prettierignore"
      - ".changeset/**"
      - ".cursor/**"
      - ".github/**"
      - ".maestro/**"
  pull_request:
    types: [opened]
    branches: [main, develop]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      platform:
        type: choice
        description: "Platform to build"
        default: "all"
        options:
          - android
          - ios
          - all
      clear_cache:
        type: boolean
        description: "Clear all caches (prebuild, gradle, pods)"
        default: false
      upload_artifacts:
        type: boolean
        description: "Upload debug and Maestro artifacts (even on success)"
        default: false

env:
  WORKING_DIRECTORY: examples/expo-multichain

jobs:
  # Gate job that allows skipping CI by including [skip ci] in commit message.
  # For workflow_dispatch events, this always runs since head_commit is not available.
  # For push/pull_request events, this checks the commit message.
  check-skip:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' ||
      !contains(github.event.head_commit.message, '[skip ci]')
    steps:
      - name: Skip CI check
        run: echo "Proceeding with workflow"

  # Job 1: Build local packages
  build-packages:
    needs: check-skip
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: 🏗 Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: 🏗 Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"

      - name: 📦 Install dependencies
        run: yarn install --immutable

      - name: 🔨 Build all packages
        run: yarn build

      - name: 📦 Pack packages
        run: |
          npm pack ./packages/appkit --pack-destination .
          npm pack ./packages/wagmi --pack-destination .
          npm pack ./packages/solana --pack-destination .
          npm pack ./packages/bitcoin --pack-destination .
          # Rename to simpler names
          mv reown-appkit-react-native-*.tgz appkit.tgz
          mv reown-appkit-wagmi-react-native-*.tgz wagmi.tgz
          mv reown-appkit-solana-react-native-*.tgz solana.tgz
          mv reown-appkit-bitcoin-react-native-*.tgz bitcoin.tgz

      - name: 📤 Upload packed packages
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: packed-packages
          path: |
            appkit.tgz
            wagmi.tgz
            solana.tgz
            bitcoin.tgz
          retention-days: 1

  # Job 2: Build and test PR - Android
  pr-build-test-android:
    needs: build-packages
    timeout-minutes: 60
    if: |
      github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.platform == 'android' || inputs.platform == 'all'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-16core

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
